caption:
A schoolgirl crushes a whole gym gang.
Seedance 2.5 made every single hit land.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds. 16:9 widescreen. Cinematic live-action realism with a supernatural edge: 35mm anamorphic look, shallow depth of field on close-ups, natural daylight from high gym windows mixed with overhead fluorescent tubes, moody teal-and-warm-wood color grade, soft haze, crisp motion with slight motion blur on hits. Camera feel: grounded handheld tracking, low floor-level angles, snap cuts on impacts. Pacing: fast ambush, a calm beat, an explosive duel, one huge impact, then stillness.

CHARACTERS:
- THE GIRL: East Asian teenage girl, slim, pale skin with a dusting of freckles across nose and cheeks, dark-brown shaggy layered wolf-cut bob with wispy bangs falling over her eyes, calm dark eyes. Navy school blazer, white shirt, dark-red tie with a pink floral pattern, navy-and-red tartan pleated mini skirt, black knee-high socks, chunky black platform Mary Jane shoes with silver square buckles. Signature: her right forearm and fist are wreathed in swirling black shadow tendrils whenever she attacks.
- THE BLOND BOY: East Asian teenage boy, lean, messy spiky bleached platinum-blond hair, sharp face. Black school blazer with white piping along the lapels and pocket edges, untucked white shirt, loosened dark tie, grey trousers, black shoes.
- THE THUGS (opening only): a heavy-set man in a black hoodie with long hair tied in a top bun and white sneakers; a man in a light-grey hoodie and grey sweatpants with white sneakers; a third man in a dark jacket and dark trousers.

LOCATION: a sunlit school gymnasium: polished honey-colored hardwood court with red and blue lines, a blue-and-yellow painted zone at one end, white walls with a navy stripe, a row of framed blue-and-white banners high on the walls, tall wooden pull-out bleachers, a stage with a maroon velvet curtain, a red folded bleacher bench, glass-backboard basketball hoops, high windows streaming daylight, fluorescent light tubes on the ceiling.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.9) — The ambush. Wide, low locked-off shot from court level: the girl stands perfectly still in the centre of the court in front of the wooden bleachers, hands at her sides. The three thugs close in on her from both sides of frame, the man in the black hoodie striding in from the right foreground, the grey-hoodie man running in from the left, the third man crouched and advancing on the left.
SHOT 2 (00:01.9-00:02.4) — Flash flurry: four snap cuts of 0.1-0.2 s each, close and handheld, as she strikes: blur of her navy sleeve, a fist connecting, white sneakers leaving the floor.
SHOT 3 (00:02.4-00:03.4) — The flip. Close, over her shoulder (her blazer and hair blurred in the left foreground): the grey-hoodie man is flipped upside down through the air in front of the maroon curtain, then lands slumped and dazed against the red bleacher bench.
SHOT 4 (00:03.4-00:04.0) — The kick. Medium-wide by the stage: the man in the dark jacket lunges at her with a flying kick; she sidesteps on her platform shoes.
SHOT 5 (00:04.0-00:05.0) — Wide: she sends him tumbling across the floor; another thug lies crumpled on the court at left; she stands in a loose fighting stance.
SHOT 6 (00:05.0-00:06.8) — The rival. Close-up profile of the girl's face, facing right, shallow focus; she turns her head to look over her shoulder. Rack focus to the background: the blond boy, standing on the top row of the bleachers, rises and squares up.
SHOT 7 (00:06.8-00:08.2) — The drop. Wide locked-off on the bleachers: the blond boy leaps off the top row, drops through the air and lands in a deep crouch on the court; the hardwood splinters and wood chips burst up around his shoes. MUST SHOW: splintered floorboards spraying up at his landing point.
SHOT 8 (00:08.2-00:08.5) — Two snap cuts: the girl blurring past in the left foreground.
SHOT 9 (00:08.5-00:09.1) — Medium, handheld: the blond boy skids sideways across the court, blazer flapping, shirt untucked; dark scorch-like spatter marks on the white wall behind him.
SHOT 10 (00:09.1-00:09.5) — Two snap cuts at floor level: the girl drops into a lunge.
SHOT 11 (00:09.5-00:10.9) — The charge-up. Low wide at floor level on the blue-and-yellow painted zone: the girl crouches like a sprinter, one hand pressed to the floor; black cracks and splintered grooves spread across the wood from her palm. MUST SHOW: dark splintering cracks radiating from her hand along the floor.
SHOT 12 (00:10.9-00:12.4) — The look. Close-up, very slow push-in: her face low, hair hanging over her eyes; she lifts her gaze into the lens with a faint smile as black shadow tendrils coil and lash around her right arm at frame left. MUST SHOW: swirling black smoke-like shadow tendrils wrapping her right forearm.
SHOT 13 (00:12.4-00:13.7) — The dash. Low tracking shot alongside her: she bursts forward low across the court, and the floor planks rip up and spray into the air in a wake behind her. Cut flurry at 12.5, 12.9, 13.0, 13.2, 13.4. MUST SHOW: a trail of torn-up wood planks and splinters flying behind her.
SHOT 14 (00:13.7-00:14.2) — Medium two-shot from behind her shoulder: she reaches the blond boy and raises her guard.
SHOT 15 (00:14.2-00:15.5) — The exchange. Low-angle handheld close two-shot looking up past them to the high windows: rapid hand-to-hand blows, blocks and grabs; he catches her forearm, she twists free. Snap cuts at 14.5 and 15.0.
SHOT 16 (00:15.5-00:16.2) — Four snap cuts, low wide: he is knocked back and skids sideways across the floor, tearing long black cracks through the hardwood.
SHOT 17 (00:16.2-00:17.5) — Wide, locked-off from court level: the blond boy slides to a halt in a three-point crouch far across the court, a long gouged trail of splinters behind him, bleachers behind.
SHOT 18 (00:17.5-00:18.4) — Frontal low angle: the girl lands on one knee in front of the maroon stage curtain, cracks bursting outward from her knee and shoe. Snap cuts at 18.0 and 18.2.
SHOT 19 (00:18.4-00:19.6) — The leap. Extreme low angle looking straight up: she soars mid-air beneath a basketball hoop and the high windows, right fist cocked back and trailing black shadow tendrils, skirt and hair flying.
SHOT 20 (00:19.6-00:20.9) — The strike. Side view, slow-motion tracking: she flies horizontally into frame from the left with her shadow-wrapped fist; the blond boy, standing, crosses both arms to brace; her fist slams down into his guard.
SHOT 21 (00:20.9-00:21.9) — The crater. Top-down shot looking straight down at the court: he is driven through the hardwood and a jagged starburst crater explodes outward, planks snapping upward, black shadow smoke and wood dust blasting out. MUST SHOW: top-down starburst crater of shattered floorboards with black smoke at the centre.
SHOT 22 (00:21.9-00:25.0) — The silence. Wide, static, floor level: the empty gym, dust and splinters drifting down through bright window light, sunbeams flaring, a lone orange basketball rolls slowly across the floor at left.
SHOT 23 (00:25.0-00:27.4) — The aftermath. Low ground-level shot: only the girl's black knee socks and buckled platform shoes visible, standing at the rim of the crater; below her the blond boy is wedged up to his shoulders in the broken planks, dust on his hair, eyes shut, then he groggily opens them.
SHOT 24 (00:27.4-00:30.2) — The calm. Frontal medium close-up of the girl, centred, in front of the maroon curtain: freckled face perfectly calm, hair slightly tousled, black smoke and dust drifting past; she glances to the side, slowly closes her eyes and lowers her head.

SOUND: no dialogue. Tense, driving percussive action score with deep hits on every strike; sneaker squeaks, cloth snaps, punches and body thuds on the hardwood; a low airy whoosh and crackle whenever the shadow tendrils appear; loud wood cracking and splintering on every floor rip; the score cuts to silence at the crater impact (SHOT 21) with a huge boom and debris rain; then only falling dust, the slow rolling bounce of the basketball and a soft low drone to the end.
prompt_short: 30s 16:9 cinematic live-action. A freckled schoolgirl with a shaggy dark bob and a shadow-wreathed fist beats three thugs, then duels a bleached-blond rival in a sunlit gym, ripping up the floor and smashing him down into a crater. Moody grade.
